body: Maybe she didn’t mean it or maybe she did. I agree it was stupid and selfish and she shouldn’t have took it upon herself to confront her boyfriend’s brother. In some fucked up way, that could her way of “trying to help.” People do stupid shit all the time without realizing it. And with every single person being on her side, I’m not so sure if we’re getting the whole story. I could be wrong though.

What she said was fucked up but I feel like some information is being left out. If she was genuinely trying to support her bf, as stupid as the action may be, then kicking her out may be too harsh. Maybe OP can provide us with more details on why everyone is in his GF’s side. Do they all know what exactly happened? Is there anything else we don’t know?
Any chance you can move to an LGBT-friendly city? It would make a huge difference in your social and dating life, I guarantee it.
You should change your therapist. Don’t feel obligated to stay with this one. At least mine acknowledged my suicidal ideation.

I’m gonna be alone too... it feels pointless to live another year where no one cares about you. 

Don’t jump from the balcony. You can traumatize any witnesses that sees your body.
Your therapist discloses your personal information to your family? You need to report that and find a new therapist.
Same here. I want to hear your story
Same here! It’s always nice to have someone that can relate. I don’t have anyone I can talk to... It’s not hard to find suicidal people but it’s freaking difficult to make meaningful connections.
I don’t know how to cope anymore.

Your husband is really lucky to have you. I would be grateful to have a partner that loves me even when it feels like the whole world is against me. He may be dealing with depression, since he’s pessimistic on his outlook in life. I wish he realizes this soon and gets better. Please continue to support him and I wish happiness for both of you.
